bundle.shortDescription: Run a coding agent with your team watching along
bundle.longDescription: SpecDeck runs a coding agent (Claude Code, OpenCode or omp) on your computer while teammates follow the terminal and, for Claude Code, a timeline of prompts, tool calls and file changes.
